recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, atmospheric rural scene featuring a central human figure standing in a field with two dogs, set against a backdrop of a weathered barn and misty, forested mountains under an overcast sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically between the foreground dog and the background barn
Misty mountain ridge line creates a soft horizontal division in the upper third
The diagonal roofline of the barn leads the eye toward the central figure
Foreground dog creates a sense of depth through shallow focus and proximity
coreInvariants: Overcast, diffused lighting without harsh shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central human figure at medium-long shot scale; secondary dog sitting adjacent; primary dog blurred in the immediate foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central standing man in dark trousers and a grey shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the blurred foreground dog, moves up to the central figure, then follows the barn roof to the misty mountains.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive grey sky and misty mountain tops provide breathing room for top-aligned text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sage green and muted olive (grass and trees)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Charcoal and deep grey (clothing and barn shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan and ochre (dog fur and weathered wood)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across all channels; mid-tones are compressed to create a flat, cinematic look.

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for an airy, prestigious feel

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space of the sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme letter-spacing to create balance across the top margin.

candidateDirections.reason: Classical proportions and sharp serifs that match the folk-rock aesthetic.
Traditional feel that complements the rural, timeless setting.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide shot of a man standing in a grassy field with a German Shepherd sitting next to him. In the immediate foreground, another German Shepherd is blurred as if running toward the camera. In the background, place a weathered wooden barn and misty, rolling green mountains under a flat, overcast sky. Apply a heavy film grain and desaturate the colors to muted greens and greys.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase serif text in the top left and top right corners. Use a dark charcoal color, medium-high contrast strokes, and set the tracking very wide (approx 250 units) so the text feels light and integrated into the sky.

verificationChecks: Is the foreground dog sufficiently blurred?
Is the color palette muted and desaturated?
Is the text placed in the top corners with wide tracking?
Does the image have a visible film grain texture?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the man's clothing is simple and non-branded
Check that the mist doesn't obscure the barn entirely
Verify the text is legible but not dominant
Confirm the aspect ratio is square (1:1)
recipe.reuseFormula: Rural Landscape + Central Figure + Animal Companion + Misty Background + Desaturated Palette + Wide-Tracked Serif Typography
